gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization grade IV glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma).

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Treatment (atezolizumab, cabozantinib): Patients receive atezolizumab IV over 30-60 minutes on day 1 and cabozantinib PO on days 1-28.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients at either first or second recurrence will be considered eligible

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Profiling tumor immune cell populations (i.e., macrophage migration inhibitory factor \[mIF\] and immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] analyses of CD4, CD8, PD1, PD-L1, and PD-L2 expression).

role_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Study to Evaluate the Safety and Clinical Efficacy of Atezolizumab (Anti-PD-L1) in Combination With Cabozantinib in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma (rGBM)

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as atezolizumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer, and may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.

role_evidence.quote: Phase I/II Study to Evaluate the Safety and Clinical Efficacy of Atezolizumab (Anti-PD-L1) in Combination With Cabozantinib in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma (rGBM)

agents.drug_class_hint: multikinase inhibitor (MET/VEGFR2/AXL); licensed for renal, hepatocellular and thyroid cancer
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Cabozantinib may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

source_quote.quote: Profiling tumor immune cell populations (i.e., macrophage migration inhibitory factor \[mIF\] and immunohistochemistry \[IHC\] analyses of CD4, CD8, PD1, PD-L1, and PD-L2 expression).

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour genomic, transcriptomic and DNA methylation profiling (WES, RNA-seq, microRNA-seq)

source_quote.quote: Profiling of tumor, e.g., deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), messenger (m) ribonucleic acid (RNA), microRNA and epigenetic profiling (DNA methylation), whole exome sequencing, RNA sequencing, and microRNA sequencing.

coder_notes: Single-arm combination of two investigational agents (atezolizumab + cabozantinib), each experimental_combination. 'WHO grade IV glioma (glioblastoma or gliosarcoma)' without IDH requirement = historical terminology. Correlative tumour immune profiling (PD-L1, CD8 etc.) and blood cytokines are planned but no paired pre/post tumour sampling or pharmacodynamic objective is stated, so target_engagement_planned coded unclear. No eligibility or enrichment biomarker.
